results.title: Assam Average Land Surface Temperature (2004-2024)
results.description: ERA5 (ECMWF Reanalysis v5) dataset, produced by the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) / Copernicus Climate Change Service, provides high-resolution, global climate reanalysis data that integrates observations with advanced modelling. From this dataset, the "mean_2m_air_temperature" band was used to extract Land Surface Temperature (LST) values which were then processed, and compared against a historical baseline to calculate temperature deviations in °C. The data was then integrated into GIS, where district and sub-district boundary shapefiles were overlaid and zonal statistics were applied to compute mean deviation values for each regioin.

results.title: Assam Gender Budget Statement 2018–25
results.description: The Assam Gender Budget Statement 2018–19, 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 is a dedicated section within the state’s fiscal framework, outlining gender-responsive allocations including stipends for adolescent girls, menstrual hygiene support, minority girl scholarships, and academic achievement awards. Through clear financial commitments, it demonstrates Assam’s early adoption of targeted gender equity measures in its public finance.
